Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing the electronic payment of utility bills.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to paying utility bills electronically; adding anew section to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35.67RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35.92 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 36.94 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 54.16 RCW; adding anew section to chapter 57.08 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 80.28RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 80.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) When a city or town that provides electric, natural gas, water,or sewer services to retail customers upgrades, changes, or purchasesnew equipment related to billing or service, the new equipment must becapable of accepting electronic payment of bills for service providedby the city or town. Additional fees or costs charged to the customermay not exceed the actual cost of providing an electronic paymentoption. (2) This section does not apply to a city or town that provideselectric, natural gas, water, or sewer services to less than fivethousand retail customer accounts. p. 1 HB 1034 (3) For the purposes of this section, "electronic payment" means aninternetbased method of payment that allows a customer, at the time ofpayment, to access an internet web page and transmit text or datacontrolling the amount of the payment, the date of the payment, and theaccount from which the payment will be made.
